run_time_in_zone_detection: run video object detection with YOLO and track dwell time of detections inside configurable polygon zones
create_polygon_zones: create polygon zones from a JSON configuration file with triggering anchors for detection zone entry
build_byte_tracker: build a ByteTrack tracker to maintain consistent object IDs across video frames during detection
annotate_video_frames: annotate video frames with colored bounding boxes and time-in-zone labels for tracked detections
run_with_cli_arguments: run the time-in-zone detection script via CLI with configurable model weights, device, and confidence thresholds
